_doc: Visual design language for the cervical-TLS workshop figures. Machine-readable companion to DESIGN.md. All colors are RGB 0-255. Single source of truth: the reference scripts load this file; prompts point the agent at it instead of hard-coding values.

canvas.note: One pixel per micron. Cells are drawn as filled segmentation polygons (not dots). Coordinates are absolute slide microns; subtract the render box min-corner before drawing.

malignancy_ramp._use: non-immune cells in the combined mask (Figure 1)
malignancy_ramp.reads_as: white at P(malignant)=0, saturated red at P=1, constant brightness

immune_ontology_ramp._use: immune cells in the combined mask (Figure 1)
immune_ontology_ramp.embedding: 1-D metric MDS on cell-ontology shortest-path distance between the immune types present, min-max scaled to the hue range
immune_ontology_ramp.reads_as: lymphoid green, myeloid blue, related types adjacent in hue

categorical_colors._use: discrete cell-type fills in the zoom figures (Figures 2 and 3)

motif_rings._use: outline rings drawn on spatial-motif anchors
